title: tracker submit and status <id> done --json
description: A submit that wasn't refused (DESIGN.md §3). A refused one prints the error shape instead. Once every gate passes, the triggers run (DESIGN.md §2.5): with none fired, result is done and the item is verified automatically, and with any fired, result is held and the item waits in review, with holds in item.holds too. gates lists G2, G5, G6, G3 and G4, which passed, since a gate that fails refuses the submit.

result.description: done when the item went straight to done, held when a trigger sent it to review.

status.description: The state the item ended in.

gates.description: Every gate that ran, with whether it passed.

secs.description: For G3 and G4, which run checks: how long their checks took together, in seconds.

triggers.description: Every trigger that ran, with whether it fired. A trigger switched off in the project's review.disabled doesn't run and isn't listed.

holds.description: Every trigger that fired, with the message saying why, which is why the item is in review. Each one is also in triggers, with fired true.

item.description: The item after the submit, exactly as its file holds it.
